config.units: G=1; star mass=1; inner initial semimajor axis=1; time measured in initial inner Kepler periods
config.scope: Chosen dimensionless model, not fitted Solar System data; deterministic finite sample, not an inferred astrophysical probability

boundaries.eventMeaning: first detected violation of a monitoring criterion; radial exit is not an asymptotic ejection proof
boundaries.eventResolution: checked at positive full-step endpoints; crossing time uncertain by at least one full step; short crossings may be missed
boundaries.energyGate: sampled once per initial inner period and at termination; necessary diagnostic, not trajectory accuracy certification
boundaries.statistics: deterministic exploratory sampling; survival fraction is conditional on this design, not an astrophysical probability
